verdict.rationale: The ESP32 board acts as the AirPlay receiver, which captures the live screen over a mirroring link. That feed drives an OpenAI-compatible vision model with separate planner and actor roles. Each run records screenshots alongside the taps and swipes drawn on top, and pointer self-calibration ties actions to on-screen coordinates, so actions are grounded on what is displayed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how each captured frame is fed to the model and how tap coordinates are derived from it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding accuracy.
